introduction: At this level, we study Sir Sydney Burrard's longitudinal division of the Himalayas based on river valleys, and we explore the Trans-Himalayas, which actually predate the formation of the main Himalayan ranges.

core_concepts.title: Punjab / Kashmir Himalayas
core_concepts.description: The part of the Himalayas lying between the Indus and Satluj rivers. It includes the Karakoram, Ladakh, Zaskar, and Pir Panjal ranges.

core_concepts.title: Kumaon Himalayas
core_concepts.description: Lies between the Satluj and Kali rivers (mostly in Uttarakhand). It contains peaks like Nanda Devi, Kedarnath, and Badrinath. The source of the Ganga and Yamuna (glaciers) are located here.

core_concepts.title: Nepal Himalayas
core_concepts.description: Lies between the Kali and Teesta rivers. This is the tallest section of the Himalayas, housing Mt. Everest, Makalu, and Annapurna.

core_concepts.title: Assam Himalayas
core_concepts.description: Lies between the Teesta and Dihang (Brahmaputra) rivers. Namcha Barwa is a prominent peak in this region.

core_concepts.title: The Trans-Himalayas
core_concepts.description: Located to the north of the Great Himalayas. It consists of the Karakoram, Ladakh, and Zaskar ranges. The Siachen Glacier (India's largest) is located in the Karakoram range.

important_entities.name: Karewas
important_entities.significance: Found in the Kashmir Valley, Karewas are thick deposits of glacial clay and other materials embedded with moraines. They are world-famous for the cultivation of Zafran (Saffron).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Geologically, the Karakoram, Ladakh, and Zaskar ranges are not part of the Himalayan fold system. They belong to the Trans-Himalayas (or Tibetan Himalayas).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Indus -> Satluj -> Kali -> Teesta -> Dihang. These rivers divide the Punjab, Kumaon, Nepal, and Assam Himalayas respectively.

exam_strategy_tips: Memorize the river boundaries perfectly. 'Which Himalayas lie between Satluj and Kali?' (Answer: Kumaon) is a staple UPSC/SSC question.
Know that the Nanda Devi peak is the highest peak exclusively within the Kumaon Himalayas.
